name: heading
label: Heading
default: A hundred years of the same standard.

default.entry_body: Four prospectors made one final attempt where Main Street runs today and hit gold. The camp that grew around that gulch became Helena, and Helena became home.
For five generations the Casteels panned placer gravel and pulled shifts underground. The trade teaches honesty fast: read the rock for what it is, and sell only ore you have assayed.
The valuable thing in this valley now is the software the local businesses, schools, and agencies depend on. SunRiver builds and secures it with the care of someone whose name is on the claim.
The oldest rule underground is to leave the workings safer than you found them. Every engagement ends the same way: clean documentation, real training, and systems your own team can run.
